title: Crystal Switches
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq M \leq 2 \times 10^5; 0 \leq K \leq N; 1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq N; u_i \neq v_i; a_i \in \lbrace 0, 1\rbrace; 1 \leq s_1 \lt s_2 \lt \cdots \lt s_K \leq N; All values in the input are integers.
